name: wims-workflow.pr-ready
description: Post-implementation chain that runs before opening a PR. Domain specialist reviews the diff, wiki synchronizer applies needed updates, validation ladder runs appropriate checks.

chain.description: Step 1: Domain specialist reviews the diff for correctness and pattern compliance
chain.task: Review the current diff for correctness and pattern compliance. Check FastAPI layering, service layering, auth/RLS, PII crypto, audit trail enforcement, PostGIS usage, Celery patterns, and test coverage. Report findings with file paths and line numbers.

chain.description: Step 2: Wiki synchronizer inspects behavioral/API/schema/security changes and applies updates if needed
chain.task: Inspect whether behavioral, API, schema, security, or infrastructure changes in the current diff require system-wiki updates. Apply updates if needed following the sync contract. If no update is required, report that no wiki changes are needed.

chain.description: Step 3: Validation ladder — run appropriate checks from root AGENTS.md based on diff scope
chain.task: Run the validation ladder: identify the scope of changes (backend, frontend, infra, docs, or cross-cutting) and execute the minimum useful checks from the root AGENTS.md validation table. Report results for each check.
